description: An object of camelCase CSS properties. Numbers become `px` for length properties. Supports CSS custom properties like `{ '--level': 3 }`.
The React prop for the HTML `class` attribute. A plain string of space-separated classes.
`*.module.css` files whose class names are rewritten to unique names. Importing returns a map: `styles.primary`.
Writing styles in JavaScript (styled-components, Emotion). Runtime versions inject CSS while rendering; zero-runtime ones (vanilla-extract, Panda, StyleX) extract CSS at build time.
A tiny helper that joins class names from strings, objects and arrays, dropping falsy values.
